methods.name: create
methods.summary: Creates and returns a new Hyperdrive configuration.
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Hyperdrive configuration.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Define configurations using a unique string identifier.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the Hyperdrive configuration. Used to identify the
configuration in the Cloudflare dashboard and API.

props.name: database
props.description: Set the name of your origin database.

props.name: host
props.description: Defines the host (hostname or IP) of your origin database.

props.name: password
props.description:
Set the password needed to access your origin database. The API never returns
this write-only value.

props.name: port
props.description:
Defines the port of your origin database. Defaults to 5432 for PostgreSQL or
3306 for MySQL if not specified.

props.name: scheme
props.description: Specifies the URL scheme used to connect to your origin database.

props.name: user
props.description: Set the user of your origin database.

props.name: access_client_id
props.description:
Defines the Client ID of the Access token to use when connecting to the origin
database.

props.name: access_client_secret
props.description:
Defines the Client Secret of the Access Token to use when connecting to the
origin database. The API never returns this write-only value.

props.name: service_id
props.description:
The identifier of the Workers VPC Service to connect through. Hyperdrive will
egress through the specified VPC Service to reach the origin database.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Set to true to disable caching of SQL responses. Default is false.

props.name: max_age
props.description:
Specify the maximum duration (in seconds) items should persist in the cache.
Defaults to 60 seconds if not specified.

props.name: stale_while_revalidate
props.description:
Specify the number of seconds the cache may serve a stale response. Defaults to
15 seconds if not specified.

props.name: mtls
ca_certificate_id
props.description: Define CA certificate ID obtained after uploading CA cert.

props.name: mtls_certificate_id
props.description: Define mTLS certificate ID obtained after uploading client cert.

props.name: sslmode
props.description: Set SSL mode to 'require', 'verify-ca', or 'verify-full' to verify the CA.

mTLS configuration for the origin connection. Cannot be used with
VPC Service origins; TLS must be managed on the VPC Service.

props.name: origin_connection_limit
props.description:
The (soft) maximum number of connections the Hyperdrive is allowed
to make to the origin database.

Maximum allowed: 20 for free tier accounts, 100 for paid tier accounts. If not
specified, defaults to 20 for free tier and 60 for paid tier. Certain
Cloudflare-managed origins may be permitted a higher limit. Contact Cloudflare
if you need a higher limit.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Replaces and returns the specified Hyperdrive configuration.
methods.description:
Replaces and returns the specified Hyperdrive configuration. The request must
include the name and complete origin connection details. Omitted caching
settings are reset to their defaults, while omitted mTLS settings and origin
connection limits are preserved. Use the update operation to modify only
selected fields.
